added game length statistic at ending screen

notes.title: EarlyAccess Patch 0.2
notes.content:
Hey players,
We are happy to announce that starting today our game supports [b]The Valve Index[/b]

Except for that, in this update you will also find few tweaks and fixes:
[list]
[*] enhanced lightning 
[*] teleport
[*] minor gameplay bugfixes
[/list]

Our goal is to make this experience even better so we’re looking forward to hearing even more from you.

Good luck, have fun, and do not crash!

notes.title: EarlyAccess - Patch 0.1
notes.content:
[i]Dear All,
thank you all for your feedback and comments. We are currently working on multiple minor bugs and improvements based on your response.[/i]

[h2]Bugfix:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed the bug with a wrong player positioning after death and now we are working on the Valve Index support.
[/list]

Stay tuned!
